name: Charles Goerens - § 33
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text: Welcomes the commitment to gender balance on executive boards of all international organisations in the Zero Draft on the FfD4 Outcome; supports the establishment of a joint committee for governance reforms in the Bretton Woods Institutions to enhance transparency, inclusivity, such as through a fairer representation in decision-making bodies and fair access to finance and diversity in leadership and staff;
